This edition's [review record](MANUAL_REVIEW_v1.md) identifies the repository sources examined and the limits of that comparison. ## Repository application and source standing This edition was compared with Chirality at revision `9b7ac5fb3c7f06cec35f24de8ebba8331bb95ac8` on 22 September 2026. It explains that identified repository basis; later work begins from the selected project's current instructions and owner directions. The [agent user manual](CHIRALITY_AGENT_USER_MANUAL_v1.md) turns the account into entry, delegation, execution, review, and continuation procedures. It remains a derivative guide, with the cited sources governing their own scope. The App and Piping persistent local-graph loops are now maintained repository instructions. Root registers `chirality-root:bundled:workflow:construct-local-work-graph` and `chirality-root:bundled:workflow:bounded-reconciliation`; their [implementation record](../../execution/_Coordination/LOCAL_WORK_GRAPH_METHODS_20260922.md) distinguishes source integration from project work. The adopted loops recover an existing graph, construct or revise it from the user's intent where needed, advance ready work, verify results, reconcile affected Deliverable documents, and preserve continuation. | Project | Entry at the examined basis | Application limit | |---|---|---| | App | [App loop](../../projects/chirality-app-dev/loop/LOOP_INIT.md), its current graph, and [project instructions](../../projects/chirality-app-dev/AGENTS.md) | The selected September 21 whole-corpus reconciliation run retains its pinned method, phase cursor, and owner gates. | | Piping | [Piping loop](../../projects/chirality-piping/loop/LOOP_INIT.md), its current graph, and [project instructions](../../projects/chirality-piping/AGENTS.md) | The selected September 21 reconciliation run likewise keeps its own basis and gates. | | Runtime | [Runtime loop](../../projects/chirality-runtime/loop/LOOP_INIT.md), accepted carrier authority, handoff, and latest receipt | No App/Piping loop replacement or inferred DAG priority is adopted by the new-method notice. | | PEC | [PEC loop](../../projects/pec/loop/LOOP_INIT.md), Deliverable `Remaining`, owner packets, and its receipt rules | The shared-method notice does not replace PEC's selection procedure or open its implementation fences. | A new loop entry does not switch a continuing whole-corpus run to bounded reconciliation, resume a pause, or waive a selected workflow's handoff and receipt contract. The current pointer locates work; its contents and dated claims still require comparison with actual work and governing decisions. The initial development sequence and percentage-labelled phases in this manual express the author's framework, not the current stage or measured completion of a repository project. The original source notes retain author attributions, archive names, external consultation dates, and domain examples as supplied in Edition 1. The original source archives and earlier editorial report are not included in this repository edition; their bytes and consultation history were not reconstructed by this review. Located repository counterparts are identified separately in the [review and source evidence](MANUAL_REVIEW_v1.md#sources-and-provenance). In particular, Chapter 2's `software-prd` is a proposed authoring method, not an entry found in the examined Root workflow catalog. Current shared publication, project adoption, run activation, actual execution, and human acceptance remain separate facts.

operations.old: A composition tree and a dependency graph give different information about the same deliverable. The tree shows which package contains B. The dependency graph shows what B needs and which other work uses its result. Contributions in different packages may have a close production relationship. Contributions in one package may be sufficiently independent to proceed separately. The organisation of execution should take account of both relationships.

Two further views help recover what the work means. A source and decision network connects claims to evidence, constraints, provenance, and supersession across folders. An attention view brings material relevant to a present question together through comparison, decomposition, and synthesis, leaving traces in briefs, decisions, and outputs. Use the views that answer the question; this does not require constructing four graphs or surveying the whole repository. Git ancestry records change history but does not by itself establish production dependency or accepted authority. [5]
